$comment: Per-repo values read by the sydevs `workflow` plugin and its skills. Values only — the rules that consume them live in the skills, the stories in docs/.

leanGate.contents: lint + typecheck + typecheck:tests + test:unit (+ targeted int specs)

contractStep.description: Payload migrations — attempt, then hand off if it hangs.
contractStep.onExit124: hand off to the user; do not retry

securityReview.rationale: Paths owning auth, client/manager records, endpoints, storage and the Payload config.

worktreeNotes: .env is git-tracked so it is already present; the dev server needs a distinct PORT (shared local Postgres via push: true).

generatedFiles.reason: `src/payload-types.ts` is generated by Payload. Run `pnpm generate:types` to regenerate it from the collection schemas. To change the types, edit the corresponding collection, field or global config.
`importMap.js` is generated. Run `pnpm generate:importmap`. To change it, edit the admin component imports in collections or globals.
Migration JSON snapshots are generated by `pnpm db:migrations:create`. Never edit them by hand — create a new migration instead.

Migration TS files are generated by `pnpm db:migrations:create` and must not be augmented (see src/migrations/AGENTS.md). If a backfill or schema tweak is needed, surface the trade-off and let the user create a new migration.
